document_contents.quote: alleges that the tax payable on supplies including zero-rated supplies as per GSTR-3B returns filed for the tax periods relating to the financial year 2020-21 was Rs.16,05,57,75,136/-, whereas as per E-Way Bill report, it was Rs.16,14,20,56,024/-, and, therefore, the petitioner was called upon to make good the short payment of tax to the tune of Rs.8,62,80,720/-.

defects_argued.quote: Having had the occasion to go through the decisions, this Court can safely say that uploading the notices and orders in the portal under the category/tab— “Additional Notices/Orders” cannot be held to be valid service contemplated under Section 169 of the GST Act.
Since the order dated 20.06.2025 rejecting the application under Section 161 of the GST Act is not a speaking order, said order cannot be held to be tenable.

outcome.quote: With the above observations and directions, the writ petition stands disposed of on the peculiar facts as pleaded.
